facts.text: The project targets the RIGOL DHO800/DHO900 SCPI oscilloscope family and was verified on a DHO804D
The DHO804D identity reply is 'RIGOL TECHNOLOGIES,DHO804D,<serial>,<firmware>'
Raw LAN SCPI is reachable on port 5555; port 5025 did not accept connections on the tested DHO804D
The instrument is identified with *IDN?
The error queue is read with ':SYSTem:ERRor?'; a reply that starts with 0 or '+0', or contains 'No error', means no error
The acquisition state is queried with ':TRIGger:STATus?'
An analog channel's display, scale and offset are read with ':CHANnel<n>:DISPlay?', ':CHANnel<n>:SCALe?' and ':CHANnel<n>:OFFSet?', and the coupling with ':CHANnel<n>:COUPling?'
The timebase scale and offset are read with ':TIMebase:MAIN:SCALe?' and ':TIMebase:MAIN:OFFSet?'
The edge-trigger level is read with ':TRIGger:EDGE:LEVel?'
Channel settings are written as ':CHANnel<n>:COUPling <value>', ':CHANnel<n>:SCALe <value>' and ':CHANnel<n>:OFFSet <value>'
The timebase is written as ':TIMebase:MAIN:SCALe <value>' and ':TIMebase:MAIN:OFFSet <value>'
The edge-trigger level is written as ':TRIGger:EDGE:LEVel <value>'
The coupling accepts AC, DC and GND (the map also accepts the alias GROUND)
The acquisition is controlled with ':RUN', ':STOP' and ':SINGle'
A measurement is queried with ':MEASure:ITEM? <item>,CHANnel<n>'
The measurement names select the SCPI items FREQuency, PERiod, VPP, VMAX, VMIN, VAVG, VRMS, PDUTy, NDUTy, RTIMe and FTIMe
The analog channels are numbered 1 to 4
Valid vertical and horizontal offset ranges depend on the active volts/div setting, the main timebase and the RUN/STOP state, so they must not be hard-coded
The device readback is authoritative because valid ranges depend on scale and acquisition state
The clone's raw TCP transport defaults to port 5555

operator_required.name: channel_scale
operator_required.reason: no text of the clone states the volts/div range of the instrument; docs/development_plan.md:148-150 says the vertical limits depend on the active volts/div setting, so the operating site sets the range of its unit

operator_required.name: channel_offset
operator_required.reason: no text of the clone states a vertical offset range; docs/development_plan.md:148-150 says it depends on the active volts/div setting, so the operating site sets the range of its unit

operator_required.name: trigger_level
operator_required.reason: no text of the clone states a trigger level range; docs/development_plan.md:148-151 and README.md:294-296 say valid ranges depend on scale and acquisition state, so the operating site sets the range of its unit

operator_required.name: timebase_scale
operator_required.reason: no text of the clone states the seconds/div range; docs/development_plan.md:148-150 says the horizontal limits depend on the main timebase and RUN/STOP state, so the operating site sets the range of its unit

operator_required.name: timebase_offset
operator_required.reason: no text of the clone states a horizontal offset range; docs/development_plan.md:148-150 says it depends on the main timebase and RUN/STOP state, so the operating site sets the range of its unit

safe_state.description: acquisition stopped (:STOP); this driver sets no instrument output
